title: Specification Persistence and Protection Protocol
description: Agent stewardship protocol for maintaining top-level features: (1) Capture user specifications to Lugs immediately, (2) Flag top-level features with load_always=true and verify_on_closeout=true, (3) Before changes impacting flagged features, ASK and explain tradeoffs, (4) Git history is authoritative record, (5) Features persist until user says otherwise. Impact: Prevents silent degradation of prime directives. Applies to: All AI agents working on this project.

t: Module-Level Version Tracking with Sub-versioning and Controlled Vocabulary
